title: THC Advanced Environment and Lighting Certificate
publicDesignation: THC Advanced Environment and Lighting Certificate

assessmentModel.knowledgeAssessment: Randomized advanced environment and lighting assessment mapped to six course objectives; certification use remains blocked until bank depth, review, pilot evidence and standard-setting are complete.
assessmentModel.retakePolicy: Maximum attempts and cooldown must follow the current approved course assessment configuration once validation is complete.
assessmentModel.completionEvidence: Course completion and final-assessment result must be retained in the Academy learner record.
assessmentModel.performanceEvidence: The required environment and lighting practical must be passed with no critical errors and verified evidence artifacts.

limitations: Does not authorize electrical repair, HVAC redesign, safety-control bypass or other work outside assigned workplace authority.
Does not replace employer procedures, equipment manufacturer requirements, regulated-worker qualifications or jurisdiction-specific requirements.
Documents Academy educational/workforce achievement and is not an independent personnel certification or government license.
